passCondition: A before/after execution observes an unchanged OS-temp proof-file set, an exact byte readback under Workshop state, no remaining run directory, exit zero, and installed false.
counterevidence: Any new matching OS-temp ZIP, output outside Workshop state, missing byte equality, surviving run directory, nonzero exit, or installed true refutes the claim.

namedSeam: The post-reproduction OS-temp baseline contains 174 matching ZIPs. One is the hash-identified diagnostic reproduction retained after deletion was refused; historical cleanup remains a separate review decision.
